description:
The chat, served by whichever gateway this installation was pointed at, may talk to the half of the application that runs on this computer.

Everything a person sees here is served by their own server, so the page that needs to reach Rust is always a REMOTE one, and Tauri gives a remote page no way to do that unless it is named. Without this the bridge simply is not there: the page calls, nothing answers, and neither half reports anything, which is exactly how a link that never connected looked from the outside.

The addresses are a pattern rather than a list because the address is the person's own, typed on first run, and there is no list to write.
